body.p: The above Amendments and these Remarks are in reply to the Non-final Office Action mailed January 2, 2025. Reconsideration and allowance of the application in view of the foregoing amendments and in view of the remarks to follow are respectfully requested.

Claims 3, 6, 11, and 13 are objected for containing informalities. Claims 1-4, 6, 7, and 9- 15 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112 as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter.

By the present amendments, Claims 1, 3, 6, and 9-13 are amended, leaving for the Examiner' s consideration Claims 1-4, 6-7, and 9-15. The Applicant respectfully submits that the proposed amendments contain no new matter. The Applicant respectfully reserves the right to prosecute any originally presented, canceled, or withdrawn claims in a continuing or future application.
III. Claim Objections and Claim Rejections under 35 U.S.C. 4112

In the Office Action, Claims 3, 6, 11, and 13 are objected for containing informalities; and Claims 1-4, 6, 7, and 9-15 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112 as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter.

In correcting the informalities, raised indefiniteness and antecedent basis issues, Claims 1, 3, 6, and 9-13 are amended. Applicant respectfully submits that the amended claims are now clear and contain no informalities; thus, the claim objections and claim rejections under 35 U.S.C. G 112 should be withdrawn.

In view of the above amendments and remarks, it is respectfully submitted that all of the claims now pending in the subject patent application should be allowable, and reconsideration thereof is respectfully requested. The Examiner is respectfully requested to email or telephone the undersigned if she can assist in any way in expediting issuance of a patent.
